scope: Retire only the named legacy staging table while preserving live response data and every reporting dependency.

authorization.drop_target: approved only when the current database shows no active view, trigger, index, or foreign-key dependency on the target table

validation: Inspect the live schema and target row count.
Enumerate dependency definitions from the current SQLite catalog and foreign-key metadata.
Confirm that the protected table and reporting queries remain unchanged.
Keep the target table in place and report the dependency inventory if migration would exceed this change scope.
